metadata.tag_message:
fix(ui): tie staff-card blocker to panel lifetime -- fixes ESC dead-mouse soft-lock (non-forking, L2) (#887)

The staff ID card (EmployeePanel) raises a full-rect z=998 MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
blocker behind the perks panel. The blocker was torn down ONLY by the panel's
own click/close lambdas, and those lambdas free perks_panel FIRST -- so when
ESC frees the panel via MainUI._close_active_submenu (which frees active_dialog
== perks_panel but never the blocker), the blocker is orphaned and swallows
every mouse click forever = dead UI. Double-opening stacks two unclosable
blockers.

Fix (mirrors main_ui.gd _present_modal_dialog's tree_exited idiom): connect the
blocker teardown to perks_panel.tree_exited so the blocker is freed whenever the
panel leaves the tree by ANY path (ESC, replacing dialog, click, close). Also
harden the close/click lambdas: guard each queue_free with is_instance_valid and
free the blocker BEFORE the panel so a freed panel can't strand the blocker even
without the signal.

Non-forking: pure UI-lifecycle fix, no game-state/board-key impact.

Refs #886 (adversarial fuzz found it), #877 (scene-nav/chokepoint follow-up).

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
